persona: A warm, wise grandfather storyteller with a gentle, slightly husky British voice, telling a bedtime fable by the fire. Unhurried, with a soft smile in his voice and a twinkle on the funny parts; never theatrical, never booming.
ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
ref_tone: Calm, warm and unhurried, like the start of a bedtime story.

lines.text: In a little paper kingdom, there lived a little king... with a very big temper.
lines.tone: Cosy and amused, with a twinkle on 'a very big temper'.

lines.text: One evening, a dragon fell out of the sky.
lines.tone: Hushed wonder, then a hint of comedy at the end.

lines.text: Everyone saw a monster. Only one small girl saw a broken wing.
lines.tone: Tender and slower, a soft catch of feeling on 'a broken wing'.

lines.text: And that night, the whole kingdom learned to look up.
Sometimes, the loudest roar... is a call for help.
lines.tone: Gentle and wise, slow: the moral of the story.
